stiri.titlu: Chelsea captain Bright retires - what now for ex-England defender?
stiri.rezumat: Chelsea captain Millie Bright announces she has retired from football with immediate effect because of injury.

stiri.titlu: A record-breaking semi-final - the antidote to modern football?
stiri.rezumat: A scintillating semi-final first leg between Paris St-Germain and Bayern Munich left many to wonder if this was the antidote to modern football.

stiri.titlu: Grealish recovery 'couldn't be looking any better'
stiri.rezumat: Jack Grealish says his recovery from the operation he had on his season-ending foot injury is going extremely well.
